notes: New: Analytics tab (bottom nav, next to Finance and Home) - category breakdown donut chart, 6-month income vs. expenses trend, and top merchants, all from your real transaction data. Fixed: the in-app update checker could hang or silently fail with no error logged if the update server was slow or unreachable - it now times out after 10s and logs failures. New: your app version is now shown at the bottom of Profile & Settings, so you can confirm which build you're on.
